Privacy Policy

Effective Date: October 15, 2026

This Privacy Policy applies to the Active Next mobile application (the "Application"), operated by Alexander Asenov (the "Service Provider" or "Data Controller").

The Service Provider respects your privacy and has designed the Application with a local-first architecture so that your personal fitness data remains strictly on your device.

1. Data Controller Contact Information

Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable data protection laws, the Data Controller responsible for the Application is:

  • Name: Alexander Asenov
  • Email: alexspx.dev@gmail.com

2. What Information Does the Application Collect and Store?

A. Fitness & Workout Data (Stored 100% Locally)

The Application does not require user registration, accounts, or cloud profiles. All data you enter into the Application—including workout logs, exercises, sets, repetitions, weights, body measurements, routines, and personal notes—is stored exclusively locally on your mobile device.

  • The Service Provider cannot view, access, collect, transmit, or store your workout or health data on any external server.
  • Because this data never leaves your device, the Service Provider does not possess any of your personal fitness records.

B. Technical & Over-The-Air (OTA) Update Data

To ensure the Application remains bug-free and up to date, the Application uses Expo Updates (expo-updates), a service provided by 650 Industries, Inc. (Expo). When the Application checks for and downloads software patches over an active internet connection, certain technical protocol metadata is automatically transmitted via HTTPS to Expo's servers:

  1. Ephemeral IP Address: Required for standard internet routing to deliver the update package.
  2. Device & OS Metadata: Basic non-identifying information such as platform type (Android/iOS), OS version, and current Application build version.
  3. Installation Identifier: A randomized, non-personal installation token generated by expo-updates solely to verify whether your specific app installation has already received an update.

Legal Basis (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b) & (f)): This minimal technical processing is strictly necessary to provide the Application's core functionality, deliver security and stability updates, and fulfill the Service Provider's legitimate interest in maintaining a functional software application. This data is never used for advertising, cross-app tracking, or user profiling.

C. Location Information

The Application does not collect, request, or track precise or coarse real-time location information from your mobile device.

D. Voluntary Direct Communication

If you contact the Service Provider directly via email (e.g., for bug reports, feedback, or support at alexspx.dev@gmail.com), the Service Provider will receive your email address and any information you voluntarily include in your message. This information is used solely to respond to your inquiry and is not shared with third parties.

3. Do Third Parties Have Access to Your Information?

The Service Provider does not sell, rent, trade, or share any personal data with third-party advertisers, analytics brokers, or marketing platforms.

The only third-party infrastructure providers involved in distributing and updating the Application are:

  • Expo (650 Industries, Inc.): Processes minimal technical request metadata strictly to deliver Over-The-Air (OTA) application code updates.
  • Google Play Services: As the distribution platform, Google collects standard OS-level installation and crash telemetry governed by your Google account settings.

4. Data Retention and Deletion

  • Local App Data: All workout and fitness data remains on your device for as long as you keep the Application installed. You can delete individual entries within the Application at any time, or permanently erase all locally stored data by clearing the Application's storage in your device settings or uninstalling the Application.
  • Support Emails: If you have contacted the Service Provider via email, you may request the immediate deletion of your correspondence and email address at any time by writing to alexspx.dev@gmail.com. The Service Provider will process deletion requests within the timeframes required by applicable law (within 30 days under GDPR).

5. Your Rights Under GDPR (European Economic Area Users)

If you reside in the European Union / European Economic Area, you have the right to:

  • Access, Rectify, or Erase any personal data the Service Provider holds about you.
  • Restrict or Object to data processing.
  • Data Portability (where applicable).
  • Withdraw Consent at any time where processing is based on consent.
  • Lodge a Complaint with your national data protection supervisory authority (in Bulgaria, the Commission for Personal Data Protection – Комисия за защита на личните данни, cpdp.bg).

Because the Application stores all user-generated fitness data locally on your device rather than on external servers, you exercise direct control over accessing, modifying, and deleting your workout data directly on your phone. For any inquiries regarding your privacy rights or email correspondence, contact alexspx.dev@gmail.com.

6. Children's Privacy

The Application is not directed at or intended for children under the age of 16 (or the applicable age of digital consent in your jurisdiction). The Service Provider does not knowingly solicit or collect personal information from children. Because the Application does not collect personal data during normal use, children's personal data is not collected by the Service Provider. If a parent or guardian discovers that a child under 16 has sent personal information to the Service Provider via email without consent, please contact alexspx.dev@gmail.com and the information will be promptly deleted.

7. Security & Data Breach Notification

Because the Application stores your fitness data locally on your device and does not transmit it to external servers, the risk of a remote server breach exposing your workout history is eliminated. We recommend securing your mobile device with a passcode or biometric lock to protect your local data.

In the unlikely event of a security breach affecting any personal data voluntarily provided to the Service Provider (such as support emails), the Service Provider will notify affected individuals and relevant supervisory authorities as required by applicable law.

8. Changes to This Privacy Policy

The Service Provider may update this Privacy Policy from time to time (for example, if optional cloud synchronization features are introduced in a future version). Material changes will be communicated by posting the updated Privacy Policy on this page with a new "Effective Date" and, where required by law, seeking your explicit consent before new data collection practices take effect.

Previous versions of this Privacy Policy are archived and available upon request by contacting alexspx.dev@gmail.com.
